races.paceDynamic: Bye Bye Now will dictate from the front as the sole confirmed leader, with An Laochmor, Snowballs, Queen Of Newark and Jordan Breeze settling prominently behind. This creates a sustainable early gallop that will allow the large hold-up contingent including Phil's Dream, Jazzit, and the fade-prone quartet of Whats It All About, Sceitimini, Star Reign and She's A Gift to get into contention turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If Bye Bye Now sets honest pace without serious early pressure from prominent group
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows hold-up horses to close strongly in final furlong. Phil's Dream and Jazzit get perfect setups to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front running dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Bye Bye Now gets soft early splits and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader capitalizes on ideal position while prominent horses struggle to respond to acceleration. An Laochmor provides main threat from forward position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent pressure backfires
scenarios.trigger: If An Laochmor, Jordan Breeze and Snowballs engage Bye Bye Now too early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo compromises all early leaders and sets up perfect scenario for patient closers. The fade-prone horses with finishing kick issues get left behind completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate pace stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If conservative early tempo leads to bunched field turning for home
scenarios.body: Positioning becomes crucial in sprint finish with little separation achieved. Prominent runners hold narrow advantage over closers in cavalry charge.

watchPoints.text: Bye Bye Now could steal long lead if prominent horses fail to track early pace closely enough

Track Jazzit's positioning through halfway point as patient ride will be crucial to chances

races.paceDynamic: Mc Loven is the sole natural front-runner and will dictate a measured pace without early pressure. The real danger comes behind as Beauty Queen, Dontspoilasale, I Bid You Ajou, I'm Spartacus and Edmond Halley all want prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems turning for home when the hold-up horses start their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Mc Loven gets an easy lead and the prominent group gets shuffled back
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the closers to make up ground, allowing Mc Loven to kick clear. The prominent runners struggle to get organized from the traffic jam.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too fast chasing Mc Loven in the middle sections
scenarios.body: The pace becomes strong enough for the closers to wind up, with clear runs deciding the outcome. Sporting Hero and Collective Power get first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battler Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets a clean break from the pack turning in
scenarios.body: Beauty Queen or I Bid You Ajou manages to avoid the traffic and gets first run on Mc Loven. The hold-up horses are left with too much to do from the steady pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If severe interference occurs in the straight affecting multiple favorites
scenarios.body: The prominent group gets completely shuffled back by traffic problems, opening the door for a cleaner-traveling outsider. Amemri or one of the other hold-up horses capitalizes on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out as Beauty Queen, Dontspoilasale, I Bid You Ajou and I'm Spartacus converge behind Mc Loven
Monitor Mc Loven's early fractions - if too slow the hold-up horses like Collective Power and Sporting Hero become dangerous
Check if Edmond Halley gets shuffled back early as his finishing limitations make recovery difficult
Watch for Collective Power getting a smooth passage as his hold-up style and current form make him the main danger if the pace is right
Observe I Bid You Ajou's position early - recent heavy ground form suggests he may not be at his best

races.paceDynamic: Love Bomb will set the pace uncontested early, with Royal County Glory and Stone Bear sitting just behind in prominent positions. This sustainable tempo favors the large hold-up brigade, creating a sprint finish where stamina becomes crucial in the final furlong as many horses with finishing concerns will struggle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb maintains honest gallop and prominent horses press
scenarios.body: The genuine pace exposes the multiple faders while allowing the stronger hold-up horses to time their runs. Faustyna and Jampa Ling benefit most from the strong early tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Pace Favors Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb goes too slow and Royal County Glory takes over
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the prominent runners to control and kick clear. Stone Bear and Royal County Glory avoid the cavalry charge finish that usually undoes them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Love Bomb Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb finds more stamina than usual at this trip
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets an easy lead and finds enough to hold off the late challenge. The sustainable pace plays into Love Bomb's hands despite the finishing concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos in Large Field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely into sprint finish
scenarios.body: The bunched field creates traffic problems and the race becomes a lottery. Lady Landhort or Dream Legend could sneak through gaps despite their limitations.

One Cool Bear's finishing kick - recent placed efforts suggest form returning despite concerns

races.paceDynamic: Saint Agatha will take the field along at a controlled gallop with Ocean's Breath, Falcon Queen and Hasita tracking closely behind in the early stages. The moderate pace will suit the hold-up horses Basilano and Allsortz, while the prominent racers will need to time their moves perfectly to avoid being swamped by closers in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Saint Agatha sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses fail to quicken
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final two furlongs as Saint Agatha weakens, allowing Basilano and Allsortz to unleash powerful finishing kicks. The hold-up specialists capitalize on their superior closing speed over the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Sustain Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean's Breath and Falcon Queen can maintain their positions without over-racing
scenarios.body: The prominent racers press Saint Agatha from the three-furlong pole, creating a genuine test of stamina. Ocean's Breath's recent good form on similar going gives her the edge over Falcon Queen in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Saint Agatha gets soft early fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader finds another gear when challenged and draws away from the field in the final furlong. Her recent placed efforts on good going suggest she can sustain a strong gallop when unopposed early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomers Dun Aonghasa or Green Amoro show significant improvement
scenarios.body: One of the unknowns produces a debut performance well above their exposed rivals' level. Their higher official ratings hint at untapped potential that could overwhelm this moderate field.

The newcomers Dun Aonghasa and Green Amoro warrant market respect given their significant rating advantages
Falcon Queen's perfect record on good going makes her the most reliable prominent option if Saint Agatha falters

races.paceDynamic: With multiple prominent runners like Mehmar, Comfort Line, Alex Belardo, Punk Poet, and Master Garvey all likely to race handy, this will create genuine early pressure despite no confirmed front-runners. The strong hold-up contingent including Palazzo Persico, Star Mind, Kitty Bear, and Alto Sax will benefit from this pace pressure, setting up a classic scenario where the early speed burns out and the patient horses sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple prominent runners (Mehmar, Comfort Line, Alex Belardo, Punk Poet) engage too early and burn each other out
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable as five horses jostle for early position, leaving them vulnerable in the final 200 yards. Hold-up horses Palazzo Persico and Star Mind find clear runs and power home strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favors Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Mehmar or Comfort Line can dictate a more measured tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners gets an easy lead and has enough left to resist the late challengers. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the good ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not suicidal, allowing patient horses to time their challenges perfectly
scenarios.body: The early leaders set up the race nicely without completely emptying their tanks, but a well-ridden hold-up horse times it perfectly. Kitty Bear or Alto Sax produces their best late kick under a patient ride.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the field settles into an even tempo with no serious early battles for position
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f marker with most horses still in contention turning for home. Form and class prevail as the higher-rated runners assert their superiority.

The good ground conditions favor the hold-up horses over the prominent runners based on the field's going preferences

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm and Expound are the two confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. With 10 hold-up horses in the field including quality operators like Liberate and Yosemite Gold, this sets up perfectly for closers if the pace becomes testing. The prominent runners Echinacea and Baila Conmigo will track the leaders but the race shape strongly favors those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm and Expound engage in a genuine speed duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The honest gallop stretches the field and sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses. Liberate and Yosemite Gold capitalize on their superior ratings when unleashed late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate pace favors prominent
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front runners gets an easy lead with the other settling behind
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with less pace to aim at from the back. Echinacea and Baila Conmigo benefit from their prominent positions to strike first.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm gets a soft lead and kicks clear before the closers can organize
scenarios.body: The leader uses superior class rating to build an unassailable advantage. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground despite the trip suiting them.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow early becomes sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are restrained early creating a crawling pace throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where position and a turn of foot matter more than stamina. Beat The Devil's versatility and recent form give him an edge in this scenario.
